description:
## Problem
`docs/internal/adr/adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md` and `docs/internal/adr/adr-independent-publication-authorities.md` split corpus authority across `published-results` (accepted archive) and `develop` (Explorer input via `scripts/site_inputs.py`), with no promotion path after the publication manifest control plane was retired (`adr-site-repo-split.md` D12). Meanwhile `results-data/` is 22.3 MB with 470 maintainer-run bundles and 0 community submissions, yet core maintains a mirror workflow, two drift checks, manual withdrawals, and a stale ledger seed.

## Change (Step 1 of 6 — owner-approved Option 1, 2026-11-24)
Write and merge a new ADR under `docs/internal/adr/` recording the owner's decision that `develop:results-data/` is the single accepted corpus archive and sole Explorer source, superseding the separate-archive clauses of `adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md` and `adr-independent-publication-authorities.md`, and cross-linking both older ADRs. Preserve surviving invariants: acceptance is distinct from deployed observation, community submissions require manual review with no auto-merge, accepted bytes are never purged, and `published-results` is frozen read-only (never deleted) only after a core release moves `benchbox submit` to `develop`.
